business_problem: Vainu needed to move away from rigid schemas and a self-managed MongoDB cluster that was expensive, hard to scale, and too operationally demanding for a growing startup team.
solution_summary: Vainu modernized its data platform by moving from a self-managed MongoDB environment to MongoDB Atlas on AWS, after previously outgrowing rigid SQL schemas during the company's early growth. The business collects and refines company and contract data for sales and marketing teams, so it needs a search-friendly platform that can evolve frequently and serve APIs at large scale. Atlas replaced manual infrastructure tasks such as backups, cluster certificates, and scaling, while AWS tooling helped the company containerize applications and optimize storage and domain management around the database. Vainu also uses pre-signed URLs for asynchronous API consumers so large customers can retrieve stored data efficiently from a global dataset that spans tens of millions of domains. The shift to Atlas gave engineers back time for application work, increased reliability and GDPR-aware controls, and sharply reduced infrastructure cost visibility problems.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Runs Vainu's production company-data platform while automating scaling, backups, rollback, and security operations.

solution_components.name: AWS
solution_components.role: Hosts the Atlas deployment and surrounding modernization tooling for Vainu's cloud environment.

data_flow: Company and contract data is collected into Vainu's global database, Atlas stores and serves that data to CRM and API consumers, larger customers retrieve exported datasets asynchronously through pre-signed URLs, and developers spin up or scale clusters as new application or test workloads appear.
business_outcome: Vainu improved uptime and security, reduced database infrastructure costs dramatically, and let developers focus on product work instead of firefighting infrastructure issues.
metrics: Vainu generated more than $2 million in revenue within three years of founding.
The company has 90 million domains in its global database.
Infrastructure costs fell from €17,000 per month to €3,000 per month.
architecture_clues: The migration to Atlas was performed gradually from a self-managed MongoDB environment.
Atlas automates backups, rollback, archival, and cluster certificates.
Separate clusters help Vainu scope compliance controls for PII and GDPR-sensitive data.
evidence_quotes: “Using a SQL database became a nightmare because of how often the schemas would keep changing.”
“All of our backups are automatically handled by Atlas so we can easily roll back without having to worry.”
“Our infrastructure costs for our cluster fell from €17,000 per month to €3,000 per month.”
“With Atlas, we can scale the clusters, or we can easily spin up new clusters.”
